title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Microsoft Learning Zone - Improve Lesson Insights
description:
See where your class is struggling and which students need support, with lesson-level results for every student. Aggregated responses show the mistakes many students made in a lesson. You can then open each student's answers to plan targeted follow-up.
